HowItWorks.heading: Three fronts, one operation
HowItWorks.intro: Automation to organize the operation, Business Intelligence to see it clearly, and artificial intelligence to accelerate it — integrated from the ground up, not patched together with loose tools.
HowItWorks.itemClientsDescription: Clients, sales pipeline, deadlines and tasks in one place, with a complete relationship history, account owners and automated notifications — built around your business process.
HowItWorks.itemLawsuitsDescription: Automated flows between systems, WhatsApp, forms and spreadsheets, with API integrations that eliminate manual, repetitive work from the operation.
HowItWorks.itemBiDescription: Tailored dashboards covering sales, operations, productivity and risk, with no spreadsheet exports or external tools to rely on. Decisions based on your own business data.
HowItWorks.itemIndicatorsDescription: Volume by area, channel and stage, risk concentration and workload per owner, to guide staffing, priorities and investment.
HowItWorks.itemRiskDescription: Every event is automatically classified — urgent, positive or routine — and summarized in plain language, prioritizing the team's workload.
HowItWorks.itemAssistantDescription: AI trained on your business context: query data, request summaries and find information in natural language, right inside your system.

About.heading: Technology born from practice, built for any business
About.paragraph1: TechTie was born from the experience of Dr. Bruno Durão, partner at BMD Dap Advocacia, one of the country's largest law firms, after facing firsthand the same problem that slows down most companies: information scattered across spreadsheets, systems that don't talk to each other, and manual processes that drain the team's time. The solution built to fix that became a product — and today TechTie brings that same technology to businesses in any industry.
About.paragraph2: We build Business Intelligence dashboards, CRMs, automations and integrations, artificial intelligence, data enrichment, and also institutional websites and landing pages — always tailored, to give managers a clear view of the operation and decisions based on data, not outdated spreadsheets.
